items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: one time I went to see him play at the, at the old fellas hall... looking at him and Carnish, and Buddy, Bollin, and Bob Lyons

ctx.x: I'm, I'm, I'm not going to cut you off, but when you were, when you were just young in the music, just starting in the music, can you remember any of the other bands they had around here? Press talks about the, uh, Bollin.
Bollin, Bollin, Bollin, yes. Oh yes, Bollin band, well that was, that was about the best band most, them times. In them times. And then the, the trumpet. How did Bollin play?
